2) Calculate the Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR):
* ARR = Control event rate - Treatment event rate
* ARR = 0.14 - 0.0893 = 0.0507 or 5.07%

3) Calculate NNT:
* NNT = 1/ARR
* NNT = 1/0.0507 = 19.72
